findingVerification.notes: The benchmark warden.toml explicitly sets defaults.verification.enabled = true.

traceCapture.notes: Run used --traces on all six published shards. Raw JSONL artifacts are withheld pending sensitive-data review; committed traceSummaries retain sanitized per-chunk metadata only.

timing.notes: Six clean shards completed sequentially within this model lane. The Grok 4.5 and Grok 4.6 lanes launched concurrently in separate Sentry checkouts. Timing remains operational context and is not ranked.

scoring.notes: Agent-verified semantic matches. A final finding counts only when it identifies the same bug at the same corpus SHA in roughly the same location. Same-file unrelated bugs and semantically unsupported merged additionalLocations do not count.

notes: Controlled Warden 0.47.0 rerun using Pi with openrouter/x-ai/grok-4.5 at high effort for scanning and openrouter/openai/gpt-5.6-luna at high effort for auxiliary extraction, verification, and merge calls. All six published shards completed with 156 successful traced chunks and no repair. The primary model emitted 80 JSON finding candidates; two used verification arrays instead of strings and were rejected by Warden's finding schema. Schema validation and auxiliary processing reduced the scan output to 55 final findings. Primary-output and final-system scoring are recorded separately in the paired analysis. Raw JSONL artifacts are withheld pending sensitive-data review.
